messages:
Maya (Support): Heads up — multiple users in acme-inc report console graphs failing to load around 2026-03-12 15:12 UTC. Console shows spinning tiles and network errors 500 from analytics-api.

support-bot: Alert: 5xx rate spike on analytics-api (service=analytics-api env=prod) — https://ops.example.com/alerts/PA-12345 :rotating_light:

Alex (eng-platform): Can you paste one curl / network trace and a correlation id? Also which dashboard and time range?

Maya (Support): Repro steps:
1) Login -> Organization acme-inc
2) Open Dashboard "Payments Overview"
3) Time range: Last 24 hours
4) Graph panels show spinner, console fetch -> 500

Example network error (from browser devtools):

GET /api/analytics/query?panel=payments-volume 500
Response headers: x-request-id: 8f2b3c1a

Liam (eng-infra): Thanks. I'm pulling traces with x-request-id=8f2b3c1a. Initial look: analytics-api returned 500 from /query fanout to aggregator-v2. Stacktrace shows ClickHouse timeout + OOM-ish errors in the aggregator logs.

Sara (support): Customer reports intermittent — sometimes page loads after retry. They also saw high error rate between 15:10-15:20 UTC.

Alex (eng-platform): Hypothesis: recent sample-rate change in aggregator-v2 (merged yesterday) increased scan complexity for some grouped queries. Could be causing heavy memory usage and timeouts. Quick mitigation: route traffic for acme-inc to legacy aggregator via routing policy. @Liam can you patch route?

Liam (eng-infra): Patching routing rule now: set routing.policy.analytics/priority=legacy for tenant acme-inc. Will monitor.

support-bot: Action taken: routing update applied (change_id=chg-9021). Rolling metrics: errors -> 200s within ~30s :white_check_mark:

Maya (Support): Confirmed with customer — graphs started returning data within 45s. They're happy for now. Will keep monitoring and follow up with postmortem.

Alex (eng-platform): Next steps: revert sample-rate-change in aggregator-v2, add memory guardrails and a targeted test for grouped queries. Assigning to eng-releases and eng-ml.

Sara (support): I'll open a support ticket linking the mitigation and timeline for acme-inc.

Maya (Support): Notes for PM/infra postmortem: time window 15:09-15:22 UTC, affected tenant acme-inc, correlation x-request-id 8f2b3c1a, mitigation: route to legacy aggregator. Attaching logs in ticket.

Alex (eng-platform): Good. Ping me if it resurfaces. :thumbsup:
